title: Compare groups of offers
hook: Two stated cases: explore composition before a society-level causal conclusion.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How composition before a society-level causal conclusion affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Rate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare composition before a society-level causal conclusion in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
